title: Effects of Baerveldt Glaucoma Implant Surgery on Corneal Endothelial Cells of Patients with No History of Trabeculectomy

indication: Glaucoma without previous trabeculectomy (including EX-PRESS), laser or peripheral iridotomy or keratoplasty; Table 1: AC group POAG 12, NVG 2, PEG 4, other secondary 5 of 23; VC group POAG 11, NVG 30, PEG 12, other secondary 9 of 62; previous cataract surgery, trabeculotomy and vitrectomy allowed

groups.description: Baerveldt glaucoma implant with the tube inserted into the anterior chamber; Toyama University Hospital 2013-2018; retrospective; one eye per patient, follow-up at least 12 months
Baerveldt glaucoma implant with the tube inserted into the vitreous cavity (requires vitrectomy; simultaneous vitrectomy in 31 eyes)

exclusions.reason: No follow-up means for the full groups; each Table 5/6 row reports its own matched preoperative mean, which is used as that series' reference
Ratios computed per eye; the absolute ECD series of the same eyes are used

exclusions.what: Tables 2-3 (odds ratios for surgical failure) and Table 4 (IOP, medications)
exclusions.reason: Model estimates or not endothelial cell density

notes: Role: anterior chamber and vitreous cavity tube insertion are two standard techniques with the same device and no investigational agent; both control-role, separate groups.

Tables 5 and 6 report, for each yearly visit, the preoperative and postoperative mean ECD of the eyes measured at that visit, so each visit forms a separate two-point series with its own reference; the series of a group share eyes.

Table 6 column 3 is headed 'Post-Operative IOP', but the caption ('The Mean of Post-Operative ECD Value in the VC Group'), the stub header '(Cells/mm2) (n)' and the Results text identify it as postoperative ECD; it is read as ECD.

Methods: for persistent corneal oedema the last reliably measured ECD was used; ECD data after a tube-position change or keratoplasty were excluded. ECD was measured preoperatively and every 6 months.
The abstract gives the VC group as n=63; Table 1 and Results give 62.
